whyNotSurfaceProbeMjs: scripts/surface-probe.mjs's ROWS registry (OPS-23) has no P-175 entry, and its built-in legs (facets-by-node-id, buildable-envelope, gis-ring, cortex-node) do not include an address-search leg at all -- P-175's own predicate is address-search-shaped ('resolves through the Find box path'), a different measurement than any existing row in that framework. Building a correctly-designed generic address-search leg plus a new ROWS['P-175'] predicate was judged, with the operator, out of scope for this close; this artifact is the honest substitute, using the same real, authenticated, live surfaces (the actual MCP connector a real customer/architect would use) rather than an internal API leg.
